senses.gloss: clear, guiltless, righteous; deserving, worthy (corresp. to b. h. צַדִּיק), opp. חַיָּיב.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 32a:5">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מגלגלין זכות ע״י ז׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00869"><he>גִּלְגֵּל</he></cite>.—<he>יום ז׳</he> a lucky day, anniversary of joyous events.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11a:7">Snh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אין דורו ז׳ לכך</he> his generation is not deserving it (<cite ref="Sotah 48b:8">Sot. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>זכאין</he>, pl.); a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:6">Snh. III, 6</cite> <he>שנים אומרים ז׳</he> if two vote, ‘Not guilty’; a. fr.

senses.gloss: entitled to possession or disposal, having authority, a right &c.; v. זָכָה.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:4">Keth. IV, 4</cite> <he>האב ז׳ בבתו וכ׳</he> the father has authority over his (minor) daughter to give her away in marriage by receiving a consideration &c.; <he>וז׳ במציאתה וכ׳</he> and has the right of possession of what she finds … and of interference with her vows; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זַכָּאִין</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:8">Ab. I, 8</cite> <he>כז׳</he> as if both (claimant and defendant) had been right.
<cite ref="Sotah 48b:8">Sot. 48ᵇ</cite>, v. supra; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="G00437"><he>זַכָּאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 45a:5">Snh. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא תצא … ז׳</he> she may be acquitted in court.
